name: Availability zone
description: Failure-isolated cloud location within a region.

code.label: Code
code.description: Technical code unique within the region.
code.help: Use the availability zone code published by the provider when available.

name.label: Name
name.description: Human-readable name of the availability zone.
name.help: Use a name that distinguishes the zone from other zones in the region.

cloud_provider_id.label: Cloud provider
cloud_provider_id.description: Cloud provider operating the availability zone.
cloud_provider_id.help: Select the cloud provider before selecting the region.

region_id.label: Region
region_id.description: Cloud region containing the availability zone.
region_id.help: Select the region to which this availability zone belongs.

form.default.name: Availability zone
form.default.description: Displays and edits an availability zone.
